title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff , M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of October, November and December , 1993. The oil Conservation Adjustment and surcharge recovers the cost of conversion fron oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
